content.text: You're a digital creator in a region where Stripe, PayPal, and other payment platforms are blocked, and you're forced to abandon your online store or navigate a maze of workarounds. Let's say you're a software developer in Nigeria where your Stripe account was rejected due to a 'high-risk' country designation. Or perhaps you're a digital artist in Pakistan who needs to sell ebooks and courses but can't use PayPal. Whatever the reason, you're about to discover a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] commerce infrastructure that lets you deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-4|Crypto Payment]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-first-principles-definitive|payments]], and own your data. No platform restrictions. No workarounds. Just pure infrastructure sovereignty.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This infrastructure works because it's built on free and open-source tools that put you in control of your digital store. You're not renting a platform or relying on a third-party payment processor. Instead, you're deploying a custom stack of Cloudflare Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments, which gives you full sovereignty over your commerce operations. This stack is designed to withstand even the most restrictive financial environments, where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are blocked or heavily restricted. By deploying this infrastructure, you're not just building a digital store – you're building a sovereign commerce platform that lets you collect payments, deliver products, and manage your data without relying on anyone else.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy this infrastructure, you'll need to set up a few things. First, you'll need a Cloudflare Pages account, which is free and gives you unlimited pages and bandwidth. Next, you'll need a Google Apps Script account, which is also free and lets you run custom backend logic. You'll also need a NOWPayments account, which is free and doesn't require any Know Your Customer (KYC) or Anti-Money Laundering (AML) verification. Finally, you'll need to have your digital products ready to sell – ebooks, courses, software, or any other type of digital goods that you want to offer. With these things in place, you're ready to deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you've deployed your Cloudflare Pages site, you'll need to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves integrating your NOWPayments account with your Google Apps Script backend, which lets you process payments and deliver digital products to your customers. You'll also need to configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure that your emails are delivered to your customers' inboxes. With this pipeline in place, you'll be able to collect payments and deliver digital products to your customers without relying on any third-party platforms.
This infrastructure is designed to withstand even the most restrictive financial environments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you can go live and start processing transactions. This involves deploying your Google Apps Script backend and configuring your NOWPayments account to accept payments. You'll also need to test your payment flow to ensure that it's working correctly. With your payment and delivery pipeline in place, you'll be able to process transactions and deliver digital products to your customers without relying on any third-party platforms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, you'll need to scale it to handle increased traffic and sales. This involves upgrading your Cloudflare Pages account to a paid plan, configuring your Google Apps Script backend to handle more traffic, and optimizing your NOWPayments account to reduce transaction fees. With these steps in place, you'll be able to scale your digital store and handle increased sales without relying on any third-party platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The key question on your mind right now is probably: 'Can I really deploy this infrastructure for free and accept crypto payments without relying on any third-party platforms?' The answer is yes. This infrastructure is designed to be free and open-source, and it lets you deploy a custom stack of Cloudflare Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments that gives you full sovereignty over your commerce operations. With this infrastructure, you can deploy your digital store, collect payments, and deliver digital products without relying on anyone else.
You can deploy this infrastructure for free and start selling digital products without incurring any costs.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure, follow these steps: Create a Cloudflare Pages account and deploy your digital store. Set up a Google Apps Script account and configure your backend logic. Integrate your NOWPayments account with your Google Apps Script backend. Configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure email deliverability. Deploy your Google Apps Script backend and configure your NOWPayments account to accept payments. Test your payment flow to ensure it's working correctly. Scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales by upgrading your Cloudflare Pages account and configuring your Google Apps Script backend to handle more traffic. Optimize your NOWPayments account to reduce transaction fees.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy this infrastructure?

Deploying this infrastructure takes around 4-6 hours, depending on your technical expertise and the complexity of your digital store. With the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy this infrastructure in just 4-6 hours and start selling digital products without relying on any third-party platforms.
What are the costs associated with deploying this infrastructure?

Deploying this infrastructure is free, and you can start selling digital products without incurring any costs. However, you may need to pay for upgrades to your Cloudflare Pages account, Google Apps Script backend, and NOWPayments account as your digital store grows and scales.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell physical products?

Unfortunately, this infrastructure is designed to sell digital products only and does not support physical product sales. However, you can use this infrastructure to sell ebooks, courses, software, and other types of digital goods that you create.
How do I integrate my NOWPayments account with my Google Apps Script backend?

Integrating your NOWPayments account with your Google Apps Script backend involves using the NOWPayments API to process payments and update your customer records. This process is documented in the NOWPayments documentation and requires some technical expertise to set up correctly.
Can I use this infrastructure to accept payments in multiple currencies?

Yes, you can use this infrastructure to accept payments in multiple currencies, including USD, EUR, GBP, and others. However, you may need to configure your NOWPayments account to support multiple currencies and update your Google Apps Script backend to handle currency conversions correctly.
